title: Establish vendor organization ownership
goal: Design and implement additive vendor-to-organization ownership and secure data boundaries required before a logistics Vendors workspace can ship.

evidence.detail: No vendor-ownership relation exists in the reconstructed live chain surface, confirming DB-012's design is genuinely new rather than a re-creation of something already present.

verification.resultReason: No hosted apply and no full typecheck were performed. The repository gates (check:migration-chain, check:migration-validation, check:migration-ledger, agents:validate) all pass, the CP-059 replay harness passes 10/10 on a throwaway local cluster, and the new migration plus its contract test were exercised on that cluster. `not-run` is retained for the hosted and typecheck criteria, which this lane could not and did not perform.

progress.summary: Wave 35 database lane: no change to this task's surface. Repo gates re-verified green at the shared HEAD (check:migration-chain 309 files, check:migration-validation repo-wide, check:migration-ledger 18 classified / 291 unreconciled, agents:validate 0 errors). Three migrations authored this wave are recorded on DB-011 and DB-008; two of them touch tables this task's acceptance criteria depend on being untouched, and both were verified to leave RLS, policies and triggers alone.
completed: No vendor_organization / vendor ownership relation or column appears among the 128 classified objects. The vendor surface that does appear is event_provider_connections (code-drift, live consumer app/api/integrations/bandsintown/status/route.ts), which is a provider-connection table, not a vendor-ownership table.
DB-012's design therefore still has to be authored from first principles; the inventory does not pre-empt it and does not create a competing vendor surface.
